text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy 
grounds……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, she left the classroom ages ago, 
though. She wasn't on the rooftop either, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Exactly! I just don't get it anymore~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me, Trainer! Have you seen 
Brian-chan around?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya checked everywhere Brian-san might 
be. So either she went outside, or else...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She's running away from Maya!! Even though 
I asked her to train together~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmph……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan probably wants to be chased, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I feel like Brian-chan can be a bit 
reserved at times... Yeah, maybe she just 
needs one more little push from Maya-chan!
choice_data_list:
(Isn't that taking optimism a bit too 
far...?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll search with you too! Let's go give 
Brian-chan a warm welcome, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yup!!
choice_data_list: Since I'm here, I'll help out too.
Since I'm here, I'll help out too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, maybe it's over there? Up in that 
tree!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're right, there's a tail sticking out! 
Nobody was there a second ago... You 
really are running away from Maya, aren't 
you~?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Judging by the way her tail looks, 
could she be taking an afternoon nap?
choice_data_list:
Let's whip up a gust from below and 
surprise them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
True, true. Forcing her awake might be a 
bit pitiful, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, if it's training, I'll keep you 
company!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—I'll prove that I can stand in 
Brian-chan's place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really? That might actually work~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head to the cafe right away! 
Maya's gonna wear mature-looking glasses☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? We're training, right? Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's adult training, see!☆ Maya wants to 
test herself to see how long she can relax 
at a café!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Sounds fun! Maybe I'll grab a coffee too♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian-san—! Wakey, wakey!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chaaan! It's not scary at all, come 
on down~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle... Thud.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't treat me like a cat.
choice_data_list: (She really was up in the tree...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I don't think you're a cat at all! 
If anything... maybe a botamochi rice 
ball?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm just lucky Maya-chan came all the way 
to our classroom! If you're doing 
training, can I join too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――I'm gonna fire both of you up!
